missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Войско' is a neuter noun in -о and stays nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'У реки' uses the genitive after 'у' to mark location. A clean model for a neuter noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Войско' is the accusative direct object of 'собрал'. As a neuter noun, its accusative equals the nominative. 'Большое' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of the whole. 'Войска' is the genitive marking the army as the whole from which a part comes. 'Часть' is the nominative subject of 'ушла'. A core part-of pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Войску' is the dative form after 'помогать', which governs the dative recipient. 'Своему' agrees in the neuter dative. A core verb-plus-dative pattern.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of agent. 'Войском' is the instrumental expressing the agent in this passive construction. 'Сильным' agrees in the neuter instrumental, and 'враг' is the nominative subject. A core instrumental pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В войске' uses the prepositional form 'войске' after 'в' to mark where. 'Порядок' is the nominative subject, and 'строгий' agrees with it. A descriptive pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Войска' is the genitive required after 'без' to express absence. 'Страну' is the accusative object of 'защитить'. A reflective conditional saying.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Войска' takes the genitive singular after 'два'. 'На границе' marks the location. A core counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Войска' is the nominative plural subject of 'идут'. 'Союзные' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'вместе' adds manner. Good for plural practice.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative goal. 'Войско' is the nominative subject of 'готовится'. 'К походу' uses the dative after 'к' to mark what it prepares for, and 'долгому' agrees. A purposeful pattern.
